SELECT sc.*, (st_distance (POINT (sc.shop_lng,sc.shop_lat),POINT(#{lng},#{lat}) ) *111195) AS distance, u.user_name FROM sc_shop sc, tb_user u where sc.status=2 and is_enable = 1 and sc.user_id = u.user_id
and sc.shop_name like concat("%",#{shopName},"%")
and sc.city like concat("%",#{city},"%")
order by browse_count desc,is_recommend asc
order by create_time desc,is_recommend asc
order by distance asc,is_recommend asc
order by create_time desc

SELECT sc.*, u.user_name, u.phone FROM sc_shop sc, tb_user u where sc.user_id = u.user_id
and sc.status = #{status}
and sc.shop_name like concat("%",#{shopName},"%")
and u.user_name like concat("%",#{userName},"%")
and sc.city like concat("%",#{city},"%")
and u.phone like concat("%",#{phone},"%")
order by sc.create_time desc

SELECT sc.*, u.user_name,
(st_distance(POINT(sc.shop_lng, sc.shop_lat), POINT(#{lng}, #{lat})) * 111195) AS distance, u.phone
,if((select count(0) from sc_follow c where c.user_id = #{userId} and type =2 and c.shop_id = #{shopId})>0,1,0) as isFollow
FROM sc_shop sc, tb_user u where sc.user_id = u.user_id and sc.shop_id = #{shopId}
